description:
Yoozy Fashion is a modern women’s fashion brand focused on feminine, trend driven styles inspired by social media fashion, everyday confidence and effortless styling.


We are building a new generation fashion community where creators, affiliates and fashion lovers can grow together while sharing their unique style and aesthetic with their audience.


What makes us different:

• Trend focused collections with strong social media appeal

• Fashion styles designed for TikTok, Instagram and modern content creation

• Long term creator opportunities and affiliate growth

• Opportunities to unlock higher commissions and exclusive creator benefits over time

• A feminine fashion brand focused on storytelling, aesthetics and community


How affiliates can earn:

• 10% commission on confirmed orders

• 30 day cookie duration

• Monthly payouts

• Affiliate links and discount codes included


How to promote us:

Creators can promote Yoozy Fashion through TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, Pinterest content, outfit inspiration posts, lifestyle content and fashion storytelling.


We are looking for creators who match the Yoozy vibe and love fashion, aesthetics and social media content creation.
payout_period: Monthly payouts after order confirmation and return validation period.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Yoozy Fashion! By joining our Affiliate Program, you agree to the following Terms and Conditions. 


For the purposes of these Terms and Conditions, “Program” refers to the Yoozy Affiliate Program. “Merchant” refers to Yoozy Fashion, and “Affiliate” refers to any individual approved to participate in the Program.

These Terms and Conditions apply to individuals accessing or using the Program, both as the Merchant (“we” or “Merchant”) and as an Affiliate (“you” or “Affiliate”) who refers customers to purchase products or services from the Merchant.

By participating in the Program, the Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and is bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approval or Rejection of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration. 

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any Affiliate account at any time if we suspect a violation of these Terms.

Important Requirement: By registering, you confirm that you are at least 18 years of age. Our payment providers and internal policies require a legal age of 18+ to enter this agreement. We reserve the right to request ID verification. Commissions cannot be issued to minors.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

An affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent valid referral will be used for commission attribution.

An Affiliate may be assigned a unique coupon code, as specified in the Affiliate  Dashboard. If a customer clicks an Affiliate link and uses a coupon code for the same order, only one commission will be issued. 

Yoozy Fashion reserves the right to determine the valid commission attribution in cases where multiple referral sources are involved, including conflicts between affiliate links and coupon codes.

Commissions are not cumulative and cannot be combined across multiple tracking methods. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.


3. Content & Social Media Guidelines 

Affiliates are encouraged to create original, high-quality content. You may advertise the Merchant website on all legal online channels (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, and other social media, blogs, or websites). You must follow local advertising guidelines (e.g., using #ad or #ambassador) in all promotional posts. Content must not contain offensive or deceptive material.

Affiliates must not promote competing fashion brands or include references to competing products or services within the same promotional content featuring Yoozy Fashion products.

Affiliates must not engage in any activity or communication that may harm, discredit or negatively impact the reputation, brand image or commercial interests of Yoozy Fashion.

By submitting content for bonuses, you grant us a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide right to use, reproduce, and repost such content for marketing and promotional purposes. This means we may share your content on our official Yoozy Fashion channels. You always remain the original creator and owner of your content.


4. Commissions and Payment

When you refer a customer who completes a purchase on our website, you will earn a commission calculated based on the order value, excluding additional fees such as taxes and shipping costs, in accordance with the applicable commission structure. If a customer clicks your affiliate link AND uses your coupon code for the same order, you will receive a single commission for that sale. Commissions are not cumulative per tracking method.

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details in Settings. The payment schedule will be notified on the Affiliate Guide page. Commissions are held in "Pending" status for 14 days to account for potential customer returns. 

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. The status of your commission is displayed in the Commission tab, and any paid commissions will be listed on the Payment tab. Transactions that result in chargebacks or refunds will not be paid out. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives the Merchant the right to review each and every referral order. This includes the right to withhold commissions in cases of suspected fraud, abuse, self-referrals, or violation of these Terms.

Content Starter Kit & Elite Rewards: New affiliates may request a one-time 50% discount to purchase products for a Content Starter Kit. This is a personal investment; no cashback is issued for this purchase. 100% Free Gifts (Elite Rewards) are exclusively reserved for top-performing affiliates in higher Tiers. Please note: All affiliate rewards and gifts exclude shipping costs unless stated otherwise.

Any products received as part of affiliate rewards, gifts or tier benefits are strictly for personal promotional use only and may not be resold, exchanged or transferred. Yoozy Fashion reserves the right to revoke commissions, rewards or affiliate status in case of misuse. Products purchased using the Content Starter Kit discount are intended for personal promotional use only and may not be resold, redistributed or commercially exploited in any way.


5. Marketing Tools

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through the Marketing tools tab. You may use these to enhance your content, but we encourage creating your own unique TikTok/social media videos for better engagement.


6. Cookies & Tracking

We use cookies to track referrals. For us to track a sale, the customer must have cookies enabled. Tracking starts the moment a customer clicks your affiliate link or uses your coupon code.

Cookie Duration: The specific cookie duration is stated on the Affiliate registration form. Within this period, any order placed by the customer on our website will automatically result in a commission for the affiliate, even if they do not click the link again for subsequent purchases.

Limitations: If a person does not allow cookies, clears their cookies, or uses a private/incognito browser, we cannot track the activity. In such cases, we cannot pay earnings on that person's activity as the system cannot link the sale to your account.


7. Removal from Affiliate Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: affiliate@yoozyfashion.com. We reserve the right to remove any Affiliate for fraudulent activity or violation of these Terms.

Affiliate Activity Requirement: Affiliates are expected to publish at least one promotional post featuring Yoozy Fashion products or services within 30 days after approval into the Program.

Inactive Accounts: Affiliate accounts that remain inactive for a period of 90 consecutive days, including but not limited to no promotional content, no referral traffic, or no generated sales, may be subject to review and removal from the Program at the sole discretion of Yoozy Fashion.

Performance Based Participation: Failure to generate promotional activity, traffic or sales over a prolonged period may result in account suspension or termination. Yoozy Fashion reserves the right to suspend or terminate any Affiliate account at its sole discretion without prior notice if participation is deemed inconsistent with the objectives or standards of the Program.


8. Program Changes

Yoozy Fashion reserves the right to modify, suspend or terminate any part of the Affiliate Program, including commission structures, rewards, tier benefits or participation requirements, at any time without prior notice.

Continued participation in the Program following any such changes shall constitute acceptance of the updated Terms and Conditions.


9. Affiliate Eligibility & Unauthorized Promotion

Only officially approved affiliates are eligible to earn commissions through the Yoozy Affiliate Program. Any individual, platform, or website that has not been explicitly approved as an Affiliate by Yoozy Fashion shall not be entitled to any commission under any circumstances, regardless of traffic, referrals, or sales generated.

The use, distribution, or publication of affiliate discount codes on third-party coupon, deal, or cashback websites without prior written approval from Yoozy Fashion is strictly prohibited.

Yoozy Fashion reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to decline, cancel, or reverse any commissions generated through unauthorized sources, including but not limited to coupon websites, deal platforms, browser extensions, or any other unapproved promotional channels.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these terms and conditions in the future. If you have questions email us at affiliate@yoozyfashion.com for support.
